format: html
filters: [stepper]
title: configured nav labels
stepper:
  prev-label: "Vorheriger Schritt"
  next-label: "Nächster Schritt"
---

## Schrittweise

The labels travel to the browser as data-prev-label / data-next-label on the
`.stepper` element; stepper.js uses them as the aria-label of the two buttons.

::: {.stepper}
```{.go code-line-numbers="1|2"}
a := 1
b := 2
```

:::: {.step-control}
Erst a.

Dann b.
::::
:::
